relationships.evidence_quote: We found that voluntary exercise (VE) activated glutamate (Glu) neurons in the medial basal Amyg projecting to the nucleus accumbens (NAc) lateral shell

relationships.subject: voluntary exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: while it almost completely suppressed NPP-induced activation of GABA neurons in the central nucleus of the Amyg (CeA)

relationships.subject: voluntary exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that VE reduced NPP-induced activation of Glu neurons in the vHIP–CA1 region of NPP model mice

relationships.subject: voluntary exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: VE in NPP model mice induces significant activation of tyrosine hydroxylase-positive DA neurons in the latVTA and GAD67-positive GABA neurons in the NAc lat shell

relationships.subject: mPFC PV-expressing GABA interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic inhibition of PV-expressing GABA interneurons has been revealed to reduce pain-related behaviors in rodent models of neuropathic pain (NPP), while optogenetic activation aggravated pain-related behaviors

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of TNF-α into the HIP of wild-type rats promotes pain-related behaviors similar to those seen in NPP model rats

key_findings: Review: voluntary exercise in neuropathic pain mice activates medBA glutamate neurons projecting to the NAc lateral shell and latVTA dopamine neurons, while suppressing NPP-induced activation of CeA GABA neurons.
Voluntary exercise reduces NPP-induced activation of vHIP-CA1 glutamate neurons and facilitates extinction of contextual fear memory, a proposed mechanism of exercise-induced hypoalgesia.
